interest: a reusable quiz tool that saves marking time and shows the department innovates
expectation: Expects an MVP demo in week 7 and a pilot with 50 students in week 14 within the 200 USD cash cap.

interest: a working product and a clear learning outcome for the team
expectation: Expects the sponsor to sign the charter in week 1 and to attend the week-7 and week-13 gates and to decide change requests within 5 working days.

role: Developers and testers (backend; real-time; frontend; QA/DevOps)
interest: a working product they can show and a fair workload of 8 hours per week each
expectation: Expects a signed charter with a fixed scope and a feature freeze in week 10 so that the MVP and pilot dates stay realistic.

interest: a quick and reliable way to join a live quiz and see their score
expectation: Expect to join a live session with a 6-character code in week 14 and see feedback and the leaderboard within 500 ms.

interest: less marking work and instant results for their classes
expectation: Expect a quiz authoring screen and an export of results to CSV and PDF that works with Khmer names before the pilot.

interest: no surprises at go-live; a runbook and a backup job
expectation: Expects a deployment checklist and the production Docker Compose file two weeks before the pilot.

role: Owns the campus proxy and Wi-Fi
interest: that the platform does not overload or break the campus network
expectation: Expects a short note by week 3 on the WebSocket traffic and the fallback so that the proxy settings can be checked.

interest: that the project meets the capstone learning outcomes and quality rules
expectation: Expects phase demos with tagged commits and evidence of tests and CI results at weeks 7 and 14.

interest: student names and results stored on campus with a retention rule
expectation: Expects a one-page data description before the pilot and can block the pilot if it is missing.

interest: a proven tool that can be used across the faculty at low cost
expectation: Expects a pilot report with results and the business-case numbers by the end of week 14.

role: Alternative supplier if the review gate switches to buying
expectation: Expects a request for an education price quote only if the week-7 demo fails and option B is used.
